qasam hai raat ki jab woh chah jaye ,
aur din ki jab uss ka ujala phel jaye ,
aur uss zaat ki jiss ney nar aur mada ko peda kiya ,
kay haqeeqat mein tum logon  ki koshishen alag alag qisam ki hain .
abb jiss kissi ney ( Allah kay raastay mein maal ) diya , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiya ,
aur sabb say achi baat ko dil say maana ,
to hum uss ko aaram ki manzil tak phonchney ki tayyari kera den gay .
raha woh shaks jiss ney bukhul say kaam liya , aur ( Allah say ) bey niazi ikhtiyari ki ,
aur sabb say achi baat ko jhutlaya ,
to hum uss ko takleef ki manzil tak phonchney ki tayyari kera den gay .
aur jab aisa shaks tabahi kay garrhey mein giray ga to uss ka maal uss kay kuch kaam nahi aaye ga .
yeh sach hai kay raasta batla dena humaray zimmay hai ,
aur yeh bhi sach hai kay aakhirat aur duniya dono humaray qabazay mein hain .
lehaza mein ney tumhen aik bharakti hoi aag say khabrdar kerdiya hai .
iss aag mein koi aur nahi , wohi bad-bakht dakhil hoga
jiss ney haq ko jhutlaya , aur mun morra ,
aur uss say aesay perhezgar shaks ko door rakha jaye ga
jo apna maal pakeezgi hasil kernay kay liye ( Allah kay raastay mein ) deta hai ,
halankay uss per kissi ka koi ehsan nahi tha jiss ka badla diya jata ,
albatta woh sirf apney uss perwerdigar ki khushnoodi chahta hai jiss ki shaan sabb say oonchi hai .
yaqeen rakho aisa shaks unqareeb khush hojaye ga .
